title: A guide to Social Media Marketing World 2027, from booking to networking
summary: Plan Social Media Marketing World 2027 in Anaheim with hotels, airports, FY2027 per diem, schedule, networking, dining, and departure tips.
body_markdown:
Social Media Marketing World 2027 will take place at the Anaheim Convention Center from April 1–3, 2027. Hosted by Social Media Examiner, the event brings marketers together for social media marketing and business-building education.\[1\]


All-Access ticket holders will begin Thursday 1st, while Marketer and AI Business World attendees start Friday. This guide covers hotels, airports, budget, agenda, networking, meals, and the general decisions most likely to affect your week:


### Key takeaways


- Arrive March 31 for All-Access workshops or April 1 for the Marketer and AI Business World programs.
- The official Hilton Anaheim block starts at $239 per night plus taxes and fees, with cancellation required at least seven days before arrival.
- Use the attendee group to arrange relevant meetings before the conference
- Choose sessions around problems you need to solve at work and bring home a specific idea to test.
- Navan Edge can book your flights, hotel, and restaurant reservations in one chat, with human travel experts available 24/7.


## What is Social Media Marketing World and who is it for?


Social Media Marketing World is Social Media Examiner's annual conference for practical education across social platforms, content, advertising, AI, video, and marketing strategy.\[1\] The 2027 speaker page includes sessions on major social platforms, short-form video, social listening, behavioral science, storytelling, conversion, and AI-supported marketing work.\[4\]


That range gives marketers several ways to shape the trip. If you need trip approval, a concrete outcome can help: perhaps an experiment, a 90-day channel plan, a better creative process, or three qualified partner conversations.


## What makes Social Media Marketing World worth the trip


You may get more from the sessions if you arrive with a question from your own work. Consider why viewers leave your videos, how to keep producing strong paid-social creative, or where AI could save your team time. When a speaker shares a promising result, hearing about their audience, budget, and team can help you decide whether the same approach might work for you.


## Where to stay for Social Media Marketing World 2027


The official Hilton Anaheim sits next to the Anaheim Convention Center, less than a five-minute walk away.\[6\] If you compare it with another property, take into account the actual route to your entrance as well as the neighborhood.

Social Media Examiner has named The Hilton Anaheim as the official hotel and lists a limited block from $239 per night plus taxes and fees. Cancellation is due at least seven days before arrival to avoid a penalty.\[6\] Alternatives may differ on room type, total price, payment timing, refundability, and loyalty treatment.


### Hotel pricing


Navan’s booking data in the Anaheim Resort District, with check-ins April 25–May 1, 2026, had a median nightly total of $299, including recorded taxes and fees. This is a historical planning reference, not a forecast for April 2027 or a sample of identified conference attendees, but it could be helpful context when planning.


## Flights to Social Media Marketing World 2027


A Wednesday, March 31 arrival would give All-Access holders some breathing room before Thursday workshops begin at noon. For Marketer and AI Business World attendees, a Thursday arrival would be comfortable for Friday's 8 a.m. opening keynote. The detailed schedule ends at 6:15 p.m. Saturday; if you plan on staying until the end, a Sunday departure avoids a rushed, same-day airport transfer.\[3\]


It helps to compare the flight, transfer, and hotel as one itinerary. A cheaper connection reaching LAX near rush hour may be less convenient than a nonstop to John Wayne Airport once luggage, transfer, and hotel check-in enter the calculation.

## How to set a budget for SMMW 2027


A useful budget includes airfare, the full hotel total, airport transfers, local rides, meals, hosted dinners, checked bags, parking, and a buffer for changes. Food is available for purchase at the convention center, so include lunch in the estimate unless your registration materials say otherwise.\[2\]


For April 2027, the federal Anaheim benchmark is $199 a night for lodging before tax and $86 a day for meals and incidental expenses.\[15\] These are federal reimbursement rates; your employer may set different limits.\[16\]


## Your Social Media Marketing World agenda


The current high-level schedule focuses on something different each day. All times are Pacific Time:


- **Thursday, April 1** : Early check-in and the Networking Plaza open at 9 a.m. All-Access workshops run noon–5:30 p.m.
- **Friday, April 2** : Check-in and the Networking Plaza open at 7 a.m.; keynotes and sessions run 8 a.m.–noon and 1:30–6:15 p.m.
- **Saturday, April 3** : Programming runs 8:30 a.m.–noon and 1:30–6:15 p.m., ending with the closing keynote.\[3\]


The public speaker page has already listed which sessions are expected.\[4\] So you can already pick the talks you want to attend, then fit them into your timetable when timings and location are available. Leaving some room for lunch, taking notes, and conversations will make the day easier to enjoy.


## What to pack for Social Media Marketing World 2027


The organizer describes the dress code as business casual.\[2\] NOAA's Anaheim average April high is 76.6°F and low is 54.1°F. Of course check the actual forecast when you come to pack.\[8\]


Here’s a small list of practical items:


- Comfortable shoes, a light outdoor layer, and an indoor layer for cool meeting rooms
- Any batteries/chargers
- Refillable water bottle and snacks you like to have to hand, and a small bag that remains comfortable all day
- A short introduction, meeting list, and one note template for sessions and conversations
- Note taking materials (pen and pad or phone/laptop). If recording content is part of your plan, check the event and speaker rules.

## How to make the most of SMMW sessions and networking


The event provides many opportunities to network. There’s an attendee Facebook group, Networking Plaza, table talks, and attendee-led meetups.\[7\] Reaching out to potential contacts a week or two beforehand gives you a chance to find people working on similar problems. Agreeing on a meeting point and a way to reach each other makes it easier to meet up in Anaheim.


A few notes about why an idea worked can be more useful than a slide full of results. You might want to ask what the speaker changed, how long it took, and what support they had. That context can help you decide what is worth trying with your own audience and budget.


A meaningful conversation is easier to continue when it ends with one specific next step. Send a short follow-up within 48 hours, and reference the actual discussion and include whatever you promised, rather than a general “It was great to meet you.”


## Where to eat during Social Media Marketing World


There are some great dining options for anyone attending the conference, and there’s something for every type of meal. Here are some recommendations:


- **Team or partner dinner: Puesto Anaheim.** Its Katella Avenue location offers private and group dining in several spaces, making it useful for a lively group.\[12\]
- **Client or executive dinner: THE RANCH Restaurant.** The restaurant and separate private dining and events center suit a more formal conversation. The room and transport are part of the choice.\[13\]
- **Flexible mixed-preference meal: Anaheim Packing House.** The two-story food hall offers varied merchants. Common areas cannot be reserved, so choose a meeting point or contact an individual merchant for a large group.\[14\]


If you would like help finding somewhere, Navan Edge can search restaurant menus and availability around your group’s preferences, dietary needs, and the atmosphere you have in mind. It can book your reservation in the same chat as your flights and hotel.


## Planning your departure from SMMW


Saturday's official programming ends at 6:15 p.m.\[3\] If attending the closing session matters to you, a same-day flight leaves less margin than a Sunday departure. If you do need to head out the same day, packing and reviewing luggage storage and airport pickup the night before can make the departure much smoother.


Once you are home, a short team conversation can help turn the sessions into something useful — an idea to try, a question to research, or a new connection to follow up with. It is worth making time for that sooner rather than later, while the examples and conversations are still fresh in your mind.
